text_en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
text_cn: 因天主的旨意作基督耶稣宗徒的保禄与弟茂德弟兄，

text_en: To the saints and faithful brothers and sisters in Christ in Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
text_cn: 致书给在哥罗森的圣徒及在基督内忠信的弟兄。愿恩宠与平安由天主我们的父赐与你们！

text_en: In our prayers for you we always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
text_cn: 我们在祈祷时，常为你们感谢我们的主耶稣基督的天主和父，

text_en: for we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love that you have for all the saints,
text_cn: 因为我们听说：你们在基督耶稣内的信德，和你们对众圣徒所有的爱德：

text_en: because of the hope laid up for you in heaven. You have heard of this hope before in the word of the truth, the gospel
text_cn: 这是为了那在天上给你们所存留的希望，对这希望你们由福音真理的宣讲中早已听过了。

text_en: that has come to you. Just as it is bearing fruit and growing in the whole world, so it has been bearing fruit among yourselves from the day you heard it and truly comprehended the grace of God.
text_cn: 这福音一传到你们那里，就如在全世界上，不断结果，不断发展；在你们那里，自从你们听到了福音，并在真理内认识了天主的恩宠那天以来，也是一样；

text_en: This you learned from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant. He is a faithful minister of Christ on your behalf,
text_cn: 这福音也就是你们由我们亲爱的同仆厄帕夫辣所学得的，他为你们实在是基督的忠信仆役，

text_en: and he has made known to us your love in the Spirit.
text_cn: 也就是他给我们报告了圣神所赐与你们的爱。

text_en: For this reason, since the day we heard it, we have not ceased praying for you and asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of God’s will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
text_cn: 为此，自从我们得到了报告那天起，就不断为你们祈祷，恳求天主使你们对他的旨意有充分的认识，充满各样属神的智慧和见识，

text_en: so that you may lead lives worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to him, as you bear fruit in every good work and as you grow in the knowledge of God.
text_cn: 好使你们的行动相称于主，事事叫他喜悦，在一切善功上结出果实，在认识天主上获得进展，

text_en: May you be made strong with all the strength that comes from his glorious power, and may you be prepared to endure everything with patience, while joyfully
text_cn: 全力加强自己，赖他光荣的德能，含忍容受一切，

text_en: giving thanks to the Father, who has enabled you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.
text_cn: 欣然感谢那使我们有资格，在光明中分享圣徒福分的天父，

text_en: He has rescued us from the power of darkness and transferred us into the kingdom of his beloved Son,
text_cn: 因为是他由黑暗的权势下救出了我们，并将我们移置在他爱子的国内，

text_en: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
text_cn: 我们且在他内得到了救赎，获得了罪赦。

text_en: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation;
text_cn: 他是不可见的天主的肖像，是一切受造物的首生者，

text_en: for in him all things in heaven and on earth were created, things visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or powers—all things have been created through him and for him.
text_cn: 因为在天上和在地下的一切，可见的与不可见的，或是上座者，或是宰制者，或是率领者，或是掌权者，都是在他内受造的：一切都是借着他，并且是为了他而受造的。

text_en: He himself is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
text_cn: 他在万有之先就有，万有都赖他而存在；

text_en: He is the head of the body, the church; he is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, so that he might come to have first place in everything.
text_cn: 他又是身体──教会的头：他是元始，是死者中的首生者，为使他在万有之上独占首位，

text_en: For in him all the fullness of God was pleased to dwell,
text_cn: 因为天主乐意叫整个的圆满居在他内，

text_en: and through him God was pleased to reconcile to himself all things, whether on earth or in heaven, by making peace through the blood of his cross.
text_cn: 并借着他使万有，无论是地上的，是天上的，都与自己重归于好，因着他十字架的血立定了和平。

text_en: And you who were once estranged and hostile in mind, doing evil deeds,
text_cn: 连你们从前也与天主隔绝，并因邪恶的行为在心意上与他为敌；

text_en: he has now reconciled in his fleshly body through death, so as to present you holy and blameless and irreproachable before him—
text_cn: 可是现今天主却以他血肉的身体，借着死亡使你们与自己和好了，把你们呈献在他跟前，成为圣洁、无瑕和无可指摘的，

text_en: provided that you continue securely established and steadfast in the faith, without shifting from the hope promised by the gospel that you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven. I, Paul, became a servant of this gospel.
text_cn: 只要你们在信德上站稳，坚定不移，不偏离你们由听福音所得的希望，这福音已传与天下一切受造物，我保禄就是这福音的仆役。

text_en: I am now rejoicing in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I am completing what is lacking in Christ’s afflictions for the sake of his body, that is, the church.
text_cn: 如今我在为你们受苦，反觉高兴，因为这样我可在我的肉身上，为基督的身体──教会，补充基督的苦难所欠缺的；

text_en: I became its servant according to God’s commission that was given to me for you, to make the word of God fully known,
text_cn: 我依照天主为你们所授与我的职责，作了这教会的仆役，好把天主的道理充分地宣扬出去，

text_en: the mystery that has been hidden throughout the ages and generations but has now been revealed to his saints.
text_cn: 这道理就是从世世代代以来所隐藏，而如今却显示给他的圣徒的奥秘。

text_en: To them God chose to make known how great among the Gentiles are the riches of the glory of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
text_cn: 天主愿意他们知道，这奥秘为外邦人是有如何丰盛的光荣，这奥秘就是基督在你们中，作了你们得光荣的希望。

text_en: It is he whom we proclaim, warning everyone and teaching everyone in all wisdom, so that we may present everyone mature in Christ.
text_cn: 我们所传扬的，就是这位基督，因而我们以各种智慧，劝告一切人，教训一切人，好把一切人，呈献于天主前，成为在基督内的成全人；

text_en: For this I toil and struggle with all the energy that he powerfully inspires within me.
text_cn: 我就是为这事劳苦，按他以大能在我身上所发动的力量，尽力奋斗。
